actions.command: cd /app && (qemu-system-x86_64 -m 512 -nographic -serial telnet:127.0.0.1:6665,server,nowait -drive file=/app/alpine.iso,media=cdrom,if=ide -boot d -net none >/tmp/alpine-qemu.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/alpine-qemu.pid) && sleep 2 && (printf '' | nc -w 2 127.0.0.1 6665 | sed -n '1,20p')

items: Launch qemu with Alpine ISO and telnet console on 127.0.0.1:6665

model_notes.notes: If the ISO does not boot to a login prompt with the initial QEMU invocation, inspect /tmp/alpine-qemu.log and adjust boot/device flags while preserving the requirement to expose the guest console on 127.0.0.1:6665.
